messages.subject: Error when running inla(): <simpleError in if (n.from.graph <= 0) {    stop(paste("Argument 'n from graph' is void:", n.from.graph))}
parts:
Hi,

I am running a model, the 'graph' parameter is specified using a .dat file, I have 20 spatial locations, each location has one or two neighbors, and this error popped up when running inla():

      <simpleError in if (n.from.graph <= 0) {    stop(paste("Argument 'n from graph' is void:", n.from.graph))}: can't specify Null when TRUE/FALSE is required

my model is like:

    formula.ST1 <- y ~ X1 + X2 + X3 + X4 + X5 + X6 + X7 + X8 + X9 +
      f(ID.area, model="besag",graph="/Users/.../adj.dat") + 
      f(ID.year, model="rw1") + 
      f(ID.year1, model="iid")

    lcs.train <- inla.make.lincombs(ID.year = diag(actualPeriodNeeded-stepahead),
                                    ID.year1 = diag(actualPeriodNeeded-stepahead))

    ST1 <- inla(formula.ST1,family="gaussian",data=data, 
                                 control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE),
                                 control.compute=list(cpo=TRUE, dic=TRUE),
                                 lincomb=lcs.train)

I have 20 locations, so n should not be <= 0 right? So I don't really understand what does it mean and how to fix it, can anyone please help me? Thanks!

Chris
